name: Touchpad Edge Controls
author: OmAjitJadhav
description: Dual-edge vertical swipe sliders for laptop touchpads on Omarchy. Right edge swipes adjust system volume; left edge swipes adjust display brightness with native Omarchy OSD feedback. Features intelligent palm rejection, multi-touch bypass, edge swapping, and a status bar toggle panel.

barWidget.description: Touchpad dual-edge sliders for volume and brightness.
